content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CMD Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Applicants must be citizens of India. Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute; equivalent qualifications need an equivalency certificate from the competent authority. Only post-qualification experience will be considered. Desirable: Assistant Manager (Projects): experience in ports, shipping, logistics, multimodal transport, container terminals, CFS/ICD operations, warehousing, maritime infrastructure, port-led industrialisation or industrial park development. Assistant Manager (Projects): experience in project planning, stakeholder coordination, logistics infrastructure development, DPR preparation, investment facilitation and land development for logistics projects. Junior Project Officer: preference for experience in marine, coastal, river training/protection structures like breakwater, seawalls, groynes, revetments, check dams.

faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Assistant Manager (Projects), 1 Finance Officer, 1 Junior Project Officer (Breakwater Construction), 1 Accounts Clerk, 1 Field Engineer.

faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.answer: It depends on the post - Assistant Manager (Projects): maximum 35 years; Finance Officer: maximum 45 years; Junior Project Officer (Breakwater Construction): maximum 45 years; Accounts Clerk: maximum 36 years; Field Engineer: maximum 30 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 42,500 (Rupees Forty Two Thousand Five hundred only) for Assistant Manager (Projects), Rs.40,000 (Rupees Forty Thousand only) for Finance Officer, Rs.35000 (Rupees Thirty Five Thousand only) for Junior Project Officer (Breakwater Construction), Rs.22,240 (Category III as per G.O.(P) No.54/2025/Fin dated 19.04.2025) for Accounts Clerk, Rs.27500 (Rupees Twenty Seven Thousand Five Hundred only) for Field Engineer.

faq.answer: Post-wise: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering plus M.Tech/MBA/PGDM (Assistant Manager); B.Com plus CA Inter (Finance Officer); B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering (Junior Project Officer); B.Com with Tally (Accounts Clerk); B.E/B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering (Field Engineer).
